description: Xiahou Yuan, swift chinese general in the supplied pixel art style. A grey iron helmet, a blue scarf, dark armor with gold trim, a quiver of arrows on his back, dark boots. He holds a brown recurve bow in the left hand
face: Sharp eyes and a short dark beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the grey helmet, the blue scarf, dark armor with gold trim, the quiver across the back, the bow at his left side.
guard_action: the left hand raises the bow in front of the body, the right hand comes to the string, the feet take an archer stance

actions.idle: Archer ready stance, bow held in front in the left hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the bow in the left hand, no shooting. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Side-on shot. Frames 1-6 he turns the body fully side-on to the target and draws; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 hold side-on. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Two quick shots. Frames 1-5 a fast draw; frame 6 release; frames 7-9 a second fast draw; frame 10 release; frame 11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Deep-drawn shot. Frames 1-7 a slow very deep draw, leaning back; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 a long follow-through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s3: Swiftness. Frames 1-5 a snap draw; frame 6 release, then the body resets fast and light on the feet; frames 7-11 he is already nocking again. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → b2 → b3, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
